title: Rate a Reference one to five stars as an editorial signal the idea pipeline reads
description: Ryan 2026-11-02: optional 1-5 stars beside Accept/Reject on every Reference surface; stars do not change the vote; latest rating wins (who, when) on the Reference; not sent to the Cyclotron. Idea pipeline: stars are among the strongest human signals with messages and the accept reason, combine, rank the queue and pack members, appear to the writer as direction, a rating change retries a rejected idea, a highly rated Reference with no idea is explained in the run record. Branch feature/reference-stars.
